pages.name: Did You Know
pages.niche: surprising true trivia: science, history, nature, space, the human body, world records and amazing places around the world
pages.guide: Start with Did you know and a surprising fact. Give 4 to 6 facts with concrete numbers, saving the most surprising one for last. Fast, curious, friendly tone.

pages.name: True Rescue Stories
pages.niche: true survival and rescue stories from different countries (trapped miners, lost hikers, shipwreck survivors, earthquake, cave and sea rescues) and famous historical stories retold
pages.guide: Tell it in order: setup, the crisis with rising stakes and specific numbers, the turning point, the rescue, the outcome. Respectful, gripping, non graphic.
